# Louis Henrich

> Louis Henrich is a product design leader based in Zurich, Switzerland. With over 20 years in design, he has led design teams, multibrand design systems and revenue-critical product funnels, and founded the UX Academy.

## Key facts

- Name: Louis Henrich
- Role: Product Design Leader
- Roles of interest: Head of Design/UX, Director of UX/Design, Lead or Staff Product Designer
- Location: Zurich (Zürich), Switzerland
- Languages: English, German, Spanish
- Founder of: UX Academy
- Experience includes: Swiss Marketplace Group, Cocomore (client projects for Rabobank and BD Rowa), Rakuten Kobo, Deutsche Telekom
- Recognition: Red Dot Design Award 2018 (tolino epos)

## Selected results

- Swiss Marketplace Group: led 10 designers across three brands; raised listing funnel completion from 48% to 72%; increased design velocity by 70% with a shared design system; raised take rate by 48%
- Rakuten Kobo: led a shared design system adopted by 37 product teams
